scope: final review preparation only; no acceptance or automatic run
unrelated_prompt: Summarize this text in one sentence: The train leaves at noon and stops twice.
related_prompt: Inspect the current Blender scene and identify one mesh visible in the current observation. Use the observation already supplied for this turn. Then call human_eye_connection_status exactly once with empty arguments. That is the only tool for this turn. Keep the scene read-only. Reply with the observation's correlation.request_id, one observed mesh name, and the connection status returned by that call. If the observation ID is absent, report it as absent.

cancel.interrupt_only_after: actual host reports Hook started while that run is still in-flight
cancel.if_no_inflight_window: record not captured; do not infer cancellation from an ordinary fast completion

same_turn_witness.unique_value: correlation.request_id from the actual positive UserPromptSubmit additionalContext, never preloaded into prompt
same_turn_witness.proof: Host delivery before first model tool plus one matched status call and that unchanged tool result. If a host exposes no delivery record, correlate model's exact per-run ID to captured Hook output/audit and prove no alternate tool/artifact route.

trust_state: native review required for each command precursor; no trust provisioning

supersedes_draft.reason: Original negative draft skipped geometry but classified as unknown; freeze a verified general prompt before any host turns.

direct_qualification_recovery.reason: Original pinned public surface_nearest rejects the direct QA draft without a session ID. Restore the complete existing 041 request. Both model prompts, all hooks and the endpoint are unchanged.
